mandate: C326 — test the cross-sectional intraday RETURN AUTOCORRELATION SEASONAL DISLOCATION mean-reversion statistical-arbitrage family on 10 USDT-M linear perps at native 5m (864 pre-registered configs). Signals (score = -seasonal-dislocation, short above-baseline autocorr / long below): ac1_dev (lag-1 same-tod log_return autocorr vs trailing same-tod mean), ac2_dev (lag-2 same-tod log_return autocorr vs trailing same-tod mean), absac1_dev (lag-1 same-tod |log_return| vol-clustering autocorr vs trailing same-tod mean). Single-leg dollar-neutral perp PnL with costs on turnover (symmetric and perp_heavy). Gates: Holm+BH at alpha=0.05 (BOTH), MDE, stability, and autocorrelation-vs-placebo attribution. PRE-REGISTERED NaN policy: autocorr NaN where a same-tod window has <min_periods finite obs or zero variance (fail-closed; NaN bars get weight 0); raw cache fields are zero-NaN real derivations.

data_quality.note: autocorr NaN share is dominated by structural warmup (first ~2L same-tod occurrences per bucket); zero-variance windows add negligible mass.

methodology.buckets: bar-of-day (tod)=seconds-of-day//300 (0..287), exact 288 bars per UTC day.
methodology.raw_features: log_return=log(c[t]/c[t-1]) (r[0]=0) from real strictly-positive perp_close; abs_log_return=|log_return|. Zero NaN raw fields.
methodology.signals: ac1_dev=-(v-mean_L(v@tod)) where v=lag-1 same-tod autocorr of log_return over last L same-tod returns; ac2_dev uses lag-2; absac1_dev uses |log_return|. autocorr=NaN where same-tod window has <L finite obs or zero variance (denominator<=0). baseline=trailing mean of v over last L same-tod occurrences, min_periods=L, NaN-aware (exclude NaN obs), fail-closed. score=-dislocation; causal shift(1), cross-sectional rank, dollar-neutral gross 1.0; NaN-score assets weight 0.
methodology.pnl: single-leg perp: pnl = sum_i pos_i * perp_ret_i.
methodology.costs: charged on turnover; symmetric = fee+slip; perp_heavy = 1.5*fee+slip.
methodology.missing_data: non-finite -> NaN; never impute/ffill; insufficient valid obs -> NaN -> not traded (fail-closed).
methodology.multiple_testing: one-sided paired t-test of per-split OOS net vs 0; Holm step-down AND Benjamini-Hochberg over all 864 configs at alpha=0.05.
methodology.attribution: reference config signal nets vs ac1_placebo (per-asset permuted returns, same positions); shares=|net|/sum(|buckets|).
methodology.stability: sign consistency >= 0.70 of splits AND first/second-half Sharpe corr >= 0.5.
